description: Your Claude Code and Codex limits wherever you look in bb: in the page header, as rings in the sidebar footer, in a band above the composer and in an optional floating widget, each coloured by whether it lasts to its reset. Shows each thread's context fill with a Compact button. Optional auto-compact, off by default, compacts an idle thread above a threshold you set; each compact runs a turn on the thread's provider and counts against its limits. Limits appear only for providers that report them to bb, today Claude Code and Codex. The server polls bb every 2 minutes and calls no provider API.
